entries.back_en: Certain motives brought us to this world. We believe that travelling here by our own means violates the rules that govern this place, which is why we keep our distance from the city's affairs. We still don't know how all of this works.

When we arrived, we came down in our ship to begin our research. I'm afraid I can't tell you its purpose, but unexpectedly an enemy took advantage that most of our troops were here on the ground and invaded our module. They seem to be airborne pirates who took an interest in our technology.
I'll be honest with you, defending the city is not what led us to seek you out, but rather the artifacts you use. Those... orbs.

As your superior, I should be demanding an explanation as to why you're in possession of an element like that, and no, that's not a joke. But I have been keeping track of your achievements under General Brigard's command. He has nothing but praise for you, did you know? So, I'll trust you. I only hope you don't get into trouble while Jivan tries to cure our soldiers.
See that beacon on top of our pod? Jump up there. Once there, use the orb on the charger's central gem core. It's an inactive mineral that can be easily recharged to restore the pod's energy.

entries.back_en: No!_100_ I mean..._100_ yes..._100_ but for a good reason.
You won't come. Once you activate the transporter for us, we won't need you anymore.
If we pull this off, I want you to let my friend here keep that... sparkly... thing... You know, that orb you lent him.
Thank you, I knew I could count on you for this request.
Don't worry, it's not a long journey. We're based on the outskirts of the city. After listening, you can decide whether or not to go, but right now you're our only hope.

I'm sorry to overwhelm you, Human, but do you believe you could find a way to activate it? Magic is something that escapes our understanding, but we are aware there are beings in the city who possess such knowledge.
